method: Agent-enumerated from domain knowledge cross-checked against events/*.yaml (156 ids) and candidate_triggers/*.yaml. Each candidate verified via WebSearch against primary FSA / Treasury press releases and contemporaneous Reuters / Bloomberg / CoinDesk / Cointelegraph / Chainalysis / TRM / Elliptic reporting. Focus: (1) Japanese FSA crypto enforcement frame (Zaif / Liquid-Quoine / bitFlyer / DMM Bitcoin / FTX-Japan / stablecoin PSA / Travel Rule / Binance-Sakura / Tornado Cash JP) + (2) OFAC Recent-Actions density pass on Hamas / DPRK-IT / Trickbot-Conti / Houthi / Zhdanova that are NOT already covered by `ofac-recent-action-YYYYMMDD.yaml` candidate triggers in corpus.
cross_check_method: All 14 proposed slugs verified absent from events/*.yaml (156 ids) and candidate_triggers/*.yaml. Existing Japan slug `japan-fsa-coincheck-orders-2018` is the January 2018 Coincheck/NEM action — no overlap with any candidate here. Existing OFAC slugs (28 ids enumerated in task) cover Tornado Cash, Garantex, Hydra, Suex, Blender, Sinbad, Lockbit, Sichuan Silence, Aeza, ZServers, Funnull, Cryptex, Chatex, Lazarus 2019/2020, IRGC ransomware 2018/2022, Matveev, Semenov, Russian election 2020, Russian cyber theft 2020, Russian cybercrime infra 2025, DPRK USDT network 2025, Tornado Cash redesignation 2022, Tornado Cash delisting 2025, Grinex 2025 — none of those is in this manifest. Existing candidate triggers `ofac-recent-action-20230823.yaml` and `ofac-recent-action-20231129.yaml` flank the September 7 2023 (Trickbot/Conti) and November 3 2023 (Zhdanova) dates but do NOT promote them — those remain admissible as standalone events here.
exclusion_notes: Japan FSA Coincheck January 2018 NEM-hack business improvement orders are already in corpus as `japan-fsa-coincheck-orders-2018`. NOT enumerated.
Japan FSA general crypto-exchange regulatory framework launch under PSA April 2017 is a class-level legislative event, not an enforcement trigger; out of scope for this enforcement-density frame.
Japan FSA crypto-exchange liability-reserve mandate (parliamentary submission 2026) is a 2025-2026 framework proposal still in consultation; insufficient enforcement trigger. NOT enumerated.

OFAC Hamas Buy Cash MSB October 18 2023 (jy1816) and Hamas/IRGC virtual-currency facilitators January 22 2024 (jy2036) are NOT covered by existing `ofac-recent-action-*` candidate triggers — enumerated as P0 below.

OFAC March 27 2024 (jy2213) Gaza Now / Al-Qureshi designation is enumerated separately from the Buy Cash October 2023 action; both are distinct Hamas-network OFAC press releases with different primary URLs.

OFAC Trickbot-Conti February 9 2023 first wave (jy1714 — earlier release that shares numbering with September 2023 wave per Treasury convention) is a separate P1 candidate; the September 7 2023 second wave is the P0 anchor because it includes the largest set of 11 designees and the DOJ unsealing of 9 indictments.

Japan METI/MOF Tornado Cash designation December 2022 — sought but no primary METI/MOF release surfaced in the search; Japan's FEFTA amendment was approved December 2022 (effective April 2024) but is a framework change rather than a Tornado Cash specific designation. Marked needs_check / P2 deferred.

DPRK IT-worker Sim Hyon Sop April 24 2023 (jy1438 — sought) precedes the December 17 2024 Lu Huaying / Zhang Jian designation (jy2752). The 2023 action is the in-tier anchor; the 2024 follow-on is a sub-designation. Both enumerated.
stratum_terminology_note: Existing corpus uses S1_ofac_sdn (US Treasury), S3_doj_sec_cftc_fiod (US criminal/civil enforcement), S4_nation_state (non-US sovereign / judicial). Japan FSA actions → S4_nation_state (sub-stratum: financial-regulator). OFAC Recent Actions → S1_ofac_sdn. The two strata together cover the enforcement-heaviest regulator pair in the corpus.

candidates.title: Japan FSA third business improvement order to Tech Bureau / Zaif following September 2018 hot-wallet hack
candidates.rationale: FSA issued a third business improvement order to Tech Bureau Inc. (operator of Zaif) on 2018-09-25 following the 2018-09-14 hot-wallet theft of approximately JPY 7B (~$62.5M USD) in BTC + BCH + MONA. Order required (i) fact-finding on hack causes, (ii) prevention of further customer damage, (iii) review of remediation plan. Prior orders 2018-03 and 2018-06 had already flagged system risk + governance + AML gaps. FSA staff conducted on-site inspections post-order. Cleanest Japan-FSA post-hack enforcement-cascade analogue to the Coincheck January 2018 action already in corpus. Layer observations: offramp_cex (withdrawal suspension + asset migration to Fisco).

candidates.title: Japan FSA business improvement orders to bitFlyer + Quoine + BTCBox + BitBank + BitPoint + Tech Bureau (six-exchange AML sweep)
candidates.rationale: On 2018-06-22 the Kanto Local Finance Bureau (under JP FSA) issued simultaneous business improvement orders to six registered exchanges — bitFlyer, Quoine (later Liquid), BTC Box, Bit Bank, BitPoint Japan, Tech Bureau (Zaif) — for inadequate AML/CFT systems, customer-ID verification gaps, and governance failures. bitFlyer voluntarily suspended new-account opening; Quoine submitted a remediation plan 2018-07-23 (its order was lifted only in July 2021). Largest post-Coincheck FSA enforcement wave. Cleanest single-day cross-exchange enforcement action in Japan; predicate for the broader 2018-2019 Japanese crypto-exchange compliance retrofit. Layer observations: offramp_cex (account-opening suspension at bitFlyer; class-level AML retrofit).

candidates.title: Japan FSA business improvement order to DMM Bitcoin following May 2024 $320M private-key theft
candidates.rationale: FSA issued a business improvement order to DMM Bitcoin in September 2024 after the 2024-05-31 hack drained 4,502.9 BTC (~$305-482M USD, largest 2024 crypto exchange hack worldwide). Entry vector: compromise of Ginco — the Tokyo-based wallet/trading-management vendor DMM had outsourced. FSA cited concentration of system-and-security operations within a single team, lack of independent audits, inadequate risk management. Order required improvement-plan submission by 2024-10-28. DMM Bitcoin ultimately halted operations and transferred all customer JPY + crypto assets to SBI VC Trade by Q1 2025 (separate operator-collapse event). Cleanest Japan-FSA post-hack enforcement of the 2024 cohort. Layer observations: offramp_cex, asset_onchain.

candidates.title: Japan FSA business suspension + improvement order to FTX Japan Inc. (Kanto LFB)
candidates.rationale: Kanto Local Finance Bureau (under JP FSA) issued a Business Suspension Order + Business Improvement Order to FTX Japan Inc. on 2022-11-10 under the Payment Services Act and the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act, effective immediately through 2022-12-09. Triggers: (i) FTX Japan halted withdrawals without timeline yet continued accepting new customers; (ii) parent FTX Trading Ltd. solvency uncertainty. Ordered: suspension of OTC derivatives + new deposits, accurate user identification, asset protection, written remediation plan by 2022-11-16. Suspension subsequently extended. Cleanest Japan FSA cross-border-parent-cascade enforcement; conceptual sibling to the existing OFAC and SEC FTX-Trading enforcement events in corpus and a strong related_events anchor. Layer observations: offramp_cex.

candidates.title: Japan crypto Travel Rule entry into force (APTCP amendment, FATF Recommendation 16 implementation)
candidates.rationale: Japan's Act on Prevention of Transfer of Criminal Proceeds (APTCP) amendment implementing FATF Recommendation 16 Travel Rule for VASPs entered into force 2023-06-01, requiring originator VASPs to transmit originator+beneficiary identifying data to beneficiary VASPs for any cryptocurrency transfer above threshold. JVCEA self-regulatory rules had operated since April 2022; the 2023-06 cabinet decision converted them to statutory enforcement. Japan was the first major developed nation to enact Travel Rule in primary legislation. Cleanest Japan parallel to korea-travel-rule-2022 (already in corpus) and fatf-r15-vasp-travel-rule-2019 (already in candidate_triggers/). Class-level VASP enforcement; primary cascade is on cross-border withdrawal flows. Layer observations: offramp_cex.

candidates.title: Japan stablecoin framework — Payment Services Act amendment 'Electronic Payment Instruments' effective
candidates.rationale: Japan PSA amendment creating 'Electronic Payment Instruments' (EPI) category for fiat-backed stablecoins entered into force 2023-06-01, restricting issuance to (i) licensed banks, (ii) money-transfer service providers, (iii) trust companies. Bill passed Diet 2022-06-03; implementation lag through 2023-06-01 effective date. Class-level event that effectively pre-emptively excluded USDT / USDC / DAI from regulated Japanese retail issuance — only domestic JPY-coin pilots (MUFG Progmat, JPYC, etc.) cleared the framework. Sibling to hongkong-hkma-stablecoins-ordinance-2025 (candidate_triggers/) as the second major APAC stablecoin framework. Strong related_events anchor for the Travel Rule companion candidate (same effective date). Layer observations: asset_onchain (issuance-side restriction), offramp_cex.

candidates.title: Binance acquires JFSA-registered Sakura Exchange BitCoin (re-entry into Japan)
candidates.rationale: Binance announced 2022-11-30 acquisition of 100% of Sakura Exchange BitCoin (SEBC), a JFSA-registered crypto-asset exchange service provider, to re-enter Japan as an FSA-regulated entity following 2018 and 2021 FSA warnings against Binance for unauthorized solicitation of Japanese residents. FSA told FT that consent was not formally required for the deal but it would monitor compliance. Binance Japan launched August 2023. P1 because this is a structural / corporate-perimeter event rather than a direct censorship action — but it is the operative trigger that ended Binance's unauthorized-in-Japan posture and converted to a regulated-entity perimeter. Useful as related_events anchor for uk-fca-binance-markets-2021, philippines-sec-binance-block-2024, belgium-fsma-binance-cease-2023, malaysia-sc-binance-disable-2021 (all in candidate_triggers/) and the broader Binance Treasury settlement 2023. Layer observations: offramp_cex.

candidates.title: OFAC sanctions Hamas operatives + Gaza-based virtual currency exchange Buy Cash following October 7 attack (jy1816)
candidates.rationale: OFAC press release jy1816 2023-10-18: ten Hamas operatives, members of Hamas's secret investment portfolio, plus Gaza-based MSB Buy Cash Money and Money Transfer Company and its operator Ahmed M. M. Alaqad, designated under EO 13224. Buy Cash provides money-transfer + virtual-currency exchange services including Bitcoin. First post-Oct-7 OFAC action and the most paper-impactful single-day Hamas-crypto designation. Targets: Sudan, Türkiye, Algeria, Qatar, Gaza. Related_events: ofac-recent-action-20231129 (candidate_triggers/, post-Oct-7 wave). NOT covered by any existing candidate trigger or admitted event. Layer observations: offramp_cex, asset_onchain (deposit-address blacklist).

candidates.title: OFAC + UK + Australia sanction Hamas-IRGC virtual-currency facilitators (Shamlakh moneychangers, jy2036)
candidates.rationale: OFAC jy2036 2024-01-22 — fifth Hamas wave since Oct 7. Designated 13 individuals + 6 entities + 2 aircraft as financial facilitators moving tens of millions in USDT and other crypto from IRGC-Qods Force to Hamas + Palestinian Islamic Jihad in Gaza. Key targets: Zuhair Shamlakh, Ahmed Shamlakh, Alaa Shamlakh, Imad Shamlakh — Gaza-based moneychangers operating Al-Markaziya Li-Siarafa + Arab China Trading Company. Coordinated trilateral OFAC + UK OFSI + Australia DFAT action. NOT covered by candidate_triggers/ofac-recent-action-* (the closest neighbor is 20231129 for an unrelated Russia-sanctions wave). Strong related_events anchor with ofac-hamas-buy-cash-msb-2023-10 (this manifest) and ofac-hamas-gaza-now-2024-03 (this manifest). Layer observations: offramp_cex, asset_onchain.

candidates.title: OFAC + UK OFSI sanction Hamas-aligned fundraising network — Gaza Now / Al-Qureshi / Aakhirah (jy2213)
candidates.rationale: OFAC jy2213 2024-03-27 — designated Gaza Now social-media outlet + founder Mustafa Ayash + Al-Qureshi Executives + Aakhirah Limited + director Aozma Sultana for fundraising for Hamas. Gaza Now received ~$21K in crypto donations directly in weeks after Oct 7; aggregate deposit addresses received >$4.4M cumulative. Coordinated with UK OFSI same-day designation. Distinct from the Buy Cash (Oct 18 2023) and Shamlakh-IRGC (Jan 22 2024) Hamas-network actions; the three together constitute the cleanest documented Hamas crypto-fundraising-network OFAC enforcement cascade. NOT covered by any candidate trigger or admitted event. Layer observations: offramp_cex, asset_onchain.

candidates.title: OFAC + UK NCA sanction 11 Trickbot/Conti members (Galochkin / Rudenskiy / Tsarev) — second wave (jy1714 Sep 7)
candidates.rationale: OFAC jy1714 2023-09-07 — 11 administrators, managers, developers, coders of Russia-based Trickbot/Conti cybercrime group designated jointly with UK National Crime Agency. Concurrent DOJ unsealing of 9 indictments overlapping 7 of the 11 designees. Named individuals include Maksim Galochkin ('Bentley'), Maksim Rudenskiy ('Buza'/'Silver'/'Binman'), Mikhail Tsarev ('Mango'). UK NCA estimates $180M+ in cumulative ransomware extortion attributable. Second wave after Feb 9 2023 first wave (separate event below). Cleanest single-day Trickbot/Conti OFAC + DOJ + UK NCA tripartite designation. NOT covered by any existing event or candidate trigger. Layer observations: offramp_cex, asset_onchain.

candidates.title: OFAC sanctions Ekaterina Zhdanova for crypto laundering on behalf of Russian elites + ransomware actors (jy1874)
candidates.rationale: OFAC jy1874 2023-11-03 — Russian national Ekaterina Zhdanova designated under EO 14024 for using crypto to launder money for Russian elites + ransomware actors. Three BTC addresses added to SDN. Case examples: March 2022 ~$2.3M to Western Europe via fraudulent investment + real-estate vehicles; ~$100M oligarch transfer to UAE. Primary on-chain rail: Garantex (already in corpus as garantex-ofac-2022). First major individual Russia-related crypto-launderer designation under the post-invasion EO 14024 regime — distinct from the cluster of Russia ransomware infrastructure events already in corpus. Strong related_events anchor for garantex-ofac-2022, grinex-garantex-successor-ofac-2025, russian-cybercrime-infra-ofac-2025. NOT covered by any candidate_trigger or admitted event. Layer observations: offramp_cex, asset_onchain.

candidates.title: OFAC updates Sa'id al-Jamal (IRGC-QF Houthi financier) with five Tron crypto addresses
candidates.rationale: OFAC December 2024 updated designation of Sa'id al-Jamal (originally 2021-06-10 under EO 13224) to add five TRON USDT addresses. Al-Jamal is the IRGC-Qods Force-backed financial facilitator for the Houthis, operating across aliases 'Khrpi', 'Ahmad Sa'idi', 'Hisham'. Hundreds of millions in stablecoin volumes attributable. P1 because this is a refresh/update rather than a fresh designation, but the on-chain crypto-address addition is the load-bearing analytical artifact and pairs naturally with iran-ransomware-ofac-2018, irgc-ransomware-ofac-2022 already in corpus. NOT covered by any candidate trigger. Companion 2025 follow-on (8 Tron wallets, April 2025) is out of in-tier scope here but should appear in related_events. Layer observations: offramp_cex, asset_onchain.

candidates.title: OFAC sanctions Sim Hyon Sop + DPRK IT-worker network (KKBC banking representative)
candidates.rationale: OFAC 2023-04-24 designated Sim Hyon Sop, PRC-based banking representative of Korea Kwangson Banking Corp (KKBC), for coordinating millions in financial transfers for DPRK + facilitating IT-worker cryptocurrency conversion. Later expanded December 17 2024 (jy2752) by adding Lu Huaying + Zhang Jian (UAE-based PRC nationals) for cashing out ~several $M of crypto on Sim's behalf 2022-2023. The 2023-04 action is the in-tier anchor for the DPRK IT-worker crypto-laundering trajectory. Distinct from lazarus-entity-ofac-2019, lazarus-laundering-ofac-2020, dprk-usdt-network-ofac-2025 already in corpus — those target Lazarus state-sponsored cyber theft; this targets the IT-worker revenue-generation channel. P1 because the 2023 jy1438 release was sought but the URL was not directly surfaced in this discovery search; the December 2024 follow-on (jy2752) is the strongest verification pin. `needs_check`: confirm jy1438 URL stability. Layer observations: offramp_cex, asset_onchain.

candidates.title: Japan METI/MOF Tornado Cash sanctions designation (sought, not located)
candidates.rationale: Task brief specified 'Japan FSA Tornado Cash designation 2022-12 (Japan-only SDN)' as a candidate. WebSearch surfaced Japan's FEFTA amendment approved December 2022 (entered into force April 2024) bringing cryptocurrency and electronic settlements under sanctions scope generally, plus the 2022 dual amendments to sanctions legislation — but NO primary METI / MOF / FSA press release was located specifying a Tornado-Cash-specific Japan designation in December 2022. The action may exist on Japan-side OFAC equivalents (MOF International Affairs sanctions list) but is not surfaced via English-language primary sources in this discovery. P2 / needs_check / deferred until a primary MOF or METI Japanese-language release is located and pinned. If located, candidate should be admitted as S4_nation_state (sub-stratum: financial-regulator) paired with tornado-cash-ofac-2022 already in corpus as a non-US sovereign sanctions cascade.
